title: What Happens If You Drink Too Much Water?
description:
What Happens If You Drink Too Much Water?

Your kidneys can clear about one litre of water an hour. Drink faster than that and it has nowhere to go: your blood dilutes, sodium drops, water floods your cells, and your brain swells inside a skull that cannot stretch. It has already killed marathon runners and people who entered water-drinking contests.

So how much is too much for YOU? Tell me in the comments.

Sources:
- Wikipedia, Water intoxication (accessed 2026-11-17)
- Wikipedia, Hyponatremia (accessed 2026-11-17)
